+/**
+ * Removes decryption metadata from an entity copied for creation. The entity cannot be used for updates afterwards.
+ */
+export function removeTechnicalFields<E extends SomeEntity>(entity: E): void {
+	const visited = new WeakSet<object>()
+
+	function removeFromObject(value: object): void {
+		if (visited.has(value)) {
+			return
+		}
+		visited.add(value)
+
+		for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
+			if (key.startsWith("_finalEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_defaultEncrypted") || key.startsWith("_errors")) {
+				delete (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
+			} else {
+				const nested = (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
+				if (nested !== null && typeof nested === "object") {
+					removeFromObject(nested)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	removeFromObject(entity)
+}
